aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Motueka, your local source for quality outdoor power equipment. Richard Mabbott built this shop on stocking the brands that work for Motueka's lifestyle block owners, farmers, and anyone who needs reliable outdoor gear.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Honda, Rover, Cub Cadet, Gravely, Atex, Hansa, Lawnmaster and Silky. Whether you need a new mower, chainsaw, trimmer or smaller tools, you'll find it here. We handle servicing, repairs and spare parts so your equipment stays in shape. Need advice on what works best for your property. That's what we're here for.

Shop in-store, online for home delivery, or use click and collect. Come and see us Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, or Saturday mornings from 9am to noon.
